iaas.question: How many cloud provider accounts (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) will you monitor?
iaas.helperText: IaaS includes cloud provider infrastructure logs such as audit activity, VM events, flow logs, storage access logs, Kubernetes control-plane logs, and configuration/inventory changes.

iaas_containers.question: How many Kubernetes or container platform clusters forward logs to Splunk?
iaas_containers.helperText: Containers / Pods / Clusters includes Kubernetes and container platform logs such as control-plane activity, audit events, node/runtime logs, and application logs written by containers.

iaas_instances.question: How many cloud virtual machines will send OS and security logs?
iaas_instances.helperText: Cloud Instances / VMs includes logs collected from cloud virtual machines through provider agents or VM log forwarding, such as OS events, authentication/security activity, agent health, and optionally application/service logs.

iaas_storage.question: How many cloud storage buckets, volumes, or file shares generate access logs?
iaas_storage.helperText: Cloud Storage includes logs from cloud object storage and cloud file storage platforms, such as management activity, object/file access requests, lifecycle or replication events, and storage health telemetry.

paas.question: How many managed platform services (databases, queues, serverless) produce logs?
paas.helperText: Platform-as-a-Service logs including managed databases, serverless functions, messaging queues, and application hosting platforms.

saas_general.question: How many distinct SaaS applications or tenants send audit logs not covered elsewhere?
saas_general.helperText: Count each SaaS application, tenant, org, or instance once. Do not enter users here; use the dedicated Office, CRM, SSO, conferencing, or file-sharing rows for user-based sizing.

saas_office.question: How many licensed Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace users generate audit activity?
saas_office.helperText: Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace audit logs—mail, files, Teams, and admin activity.

saas_crm.question: How many active CRM users (Salesforce, Dynamics, etc.) generate audit logs?
saas_crm.helperText: CRM audit logs (Salesforce, Dynamics, etc.) for logins, record changes, and integrations.

saas_sso.question: How many users authenticate through your cloud identity provider?
saas_sso.helperText: Sign-in and MFA events from your cloud identity provider (Okta, Entra, Ping) for SaaS and VPN apps.

saas_conferencing.question: How many licensed web conferencing users (Zoom, Teams, Webex) forward meeting audit logs?
saas_conferencing.helperText: Web conferencing audit logs (Zoom, Teams, Webex, Slack huddles): meetings, recordings, admin settings, and sign-in activity forwarded to Splunk.

saas_filesharing.question: How many collaboration platform users (Box, Dropbox, OneDrive) generate file-sharing audit logs?
saas_filesharing.helperText: Enterprise file-sharing audit logs (Box, Dropbox, OneDrive standalone tenants): file access, sharing links, admin actions, and DLP-related events.

cspm.question: How many cloud accounts does your CSPM tool continuously assess?
cspm.helperText: CSPM tools continuously monitor cloud infrastructure for misconfigurations, compliance violations, and security risks.

cwpp.question: How many cloud workloads (VMs, containers, serverless) does your CWPP agent protect?
cwpp.helperText: Runtime protection for cloud workloads including VMs, containers, and serverless functions.

casb.question: How many users are covered by CASB policy and audit logging?
casb.helperText: Policy/alert CASB feeds (discovery, violations, admin changes) — default ~0.005 GB/user/day. Full inline SaaS proxy logging is ~0.05 GB/user/day; use SASE source if all user web traffic is proxied.

sase.question: How many remote users connect through your SASE platform?
sase.helperText: Secure access edge logs for remote users (SWG, ZTNA, CASB bundle).

windows_servers.question: How many Windows servers forward event logs to Splunk?
windows_servers.helperText: Windows Event Logs from physical and virtual servers.

linux_servers.question: How many production Linux or Unix servers send syslog and security logs?
linux_servers.helperText: System logs from production Linux/Unix servers including syslog, auth logs, performance metrics, and security events.

mainframe.question: How many mainframe LPARs or logical systems forward SMF and security logs?
mainframe.helperText: Mainframe system logs including SMF records, RACF security events, and system activity.

linux_servers_nonprod.question: How many dev, test, or staging Linux/Unix servers forward logs?
linux_servers_nonprod.helperText: System logs from development, test, and staging Linux/Unix environments.

hypervisor.question: How many hypervisor hosts or management platforms (vCenter, Hyper-V) forward logs?
hypervisor.helperText: Hypervisor and virtual infrastructure management logs from VMware vCenter, ESXi hosts, Hyper-V, and other platforms.

database.question: How many database instances (relational or NoSQL) send audit and error logs?
database.helperText: Database audit logs, transaction logs, access logs, and error logs from relational and NoSQL database systems.

db_transaction.question: How many database instances capture transaction or SQL audit streams?
db_transaction.helperText: Database transaction or SQL audit streams capturing DML/DDL activity, sensitive table access, and application database calls.

db_access.question: How many database instances capture access and authentication audit logs?
db_access.helperText: Database access and authentication audit logs (DBA actions, failed logins, privilege use) from enterprise RDBMS platforms.

web_servers.question: How many production web servers hosting HTTP/HTTPS applications forward access logs?
web_servers.helperText: Web server access logs, error logs, and performance metrics from HTTP/HTTPS serving infrastructure.

app_servers.question: How many production application servers (J2EE, .NET, etc.) forward application logs?
app_servers.helperText: Application server logs including J2EE containers, .

middleware.question: How many production message queues, ESBs, or integration platforms forward logs?
middleware.helperText: Message queuing, ESB, and integration platform logs.

business_txn.question: How many business applications produce instrumented transaction logs?
business_txn.helperText: Application-level business transaction logs including order processing, payment systems, and ERP activity.

apm.question: How many applications are monitored by your APM platform?
apm.helperText: Application performance metrics, traces, and error tracking from APM platforms.

pki.question: How many certificate authority or PKI servers log issuance and revocation events?
pki.helperText: Certificate lifecycle logs including issuance, revocation, renewal, and enrollment events.

sap.question: How many SAP systems (ERP, S/4HANA, etc.) forward security and change logs?
sap.helperText: SAP application logs including security audit logs, change documents, and transaction logs.

desktops.question: How many end-user workstations or laptops forward desktop logs?
desktops.helperText: Windows Event Logs, macOS unified logs, and Linux desktop logs from end-user workstations.

sso_pam.question: How many PAM or vault platforms forward privileged-access audit logs?
sso_pam.helperText: Privileged-access and vault session logs from PAM tools (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)—not the same as everyday SSO sign-ins.

active_directory.question: How many Active Directory domain controllers send logs to Splunk?
active_directory.helperText: On-prem Windows domain controller security logs (Kerberos, logons, group changes).

email.question: How many mail servers or secure email gateways forward message tracking logs?
email.helperText: On-prem mail server or secure email gateway message tracking and threat logs.

mdm.question: How many mobile devices are enrolled and managed by your MDM platform?
mdm.helperText: MDM platform logs including device compliance, app deployment, and security policy enforcement.

vuln_mgmt.question: How many vulnerability scanners or scan managers feed results to Splunk?
vuln_mgmt.helperText: Vulnerability scanner results, compliance scan data, and asset discovery information.

netflow.question: How many network devices export NetFlow, sFlow, or IPFIX to Splunk?
netflow.helperText: NetFlow, sFlow, or IPFIX metadata from routers, switches, or firewalls.

ids_ips.question: How many network IDS/IPS sensors or managers forward alert logs?
ids_ips.helperText: Alert and event logs from network-based intrusion detection and prevention systems.

threat_intel.question: How many distinct threat intelligence feeds does Splunk ingest?
threat_intel.helperText: Threat intelligence indicators (IOCs), threat actor profiles, and campaign information from commercial and open-source feeds.

sandbox.question: How many malware sandbox or detonation systems forward analysis results?
sandbox.helperText: Sandbox detonation results including behavioral analysis, IOC extraction, and verdict information.

dlp.question: How many users or endpoints are monitored by your DLP solution?
dlp.unitLabel: active users / endpoints monitored by DLP
dlp.helperText: Count active users or endpoints that can generate DLP incidents. This sizes policy violations and incident records, not full endpoint telemetry or inspected content.

edr.question: How many endpoints report into this platform daily?
edr.helperText: Endpoint detection alerts and telemetry from your EDR platform (CrowdStrike, Defender, etc.).

ndr.question: How many NDR sensors or collectors analyze network traffic for threats?
ndr.helperText: Network-based detection and response platform logs including lateral movement alerts, encrypted traffic analysis, and behavioral anomalies.

deception.question: How many honeypot, honeytoken, or deception decoy systems are deployed?
deception.helperText: Honeypot, honeytoken, and deception platform alerts indicating interaction with decoy systems or credentials.

web_servers_nonprod.question: How many non-production web servers in dev, test, or staging forward logs?
web_servers_nonprod.helperText: Web server access logs, error logs, and performance metrics from dev, test, and staging HTTP/HTTPS environments.

app_servers_nonprod.question: How many non-production application servers forward logs?
app_servers_nonprod.helperText: Application server logs from development, test, and staging J2EE, .

middleware_nonprod.question: How many non-production middleware systems forward logs?
middleware_nonprod.helperText: Message queuing, ESB, and integration platform logs from dev, test, and staging environments.

config_mgmt.question: How many servers are managed by your configuration management platform?
config_mgmt.helperText: Configuration management platform logs including state changes, compliance drift, and deployment activities.

devops_cicd.question: How many CI/CD pipelines or build servers forward deployment logs?
devops_cicd.helperText: Build system, deployment pipeline, and CI/CD platform logs including build results, deployments, and artifact management.

switches.question: How many managed network switches forward syslog or SNMP trap logs?
switches.helperText: Switch logs including port security, VLAN changes, spanning tree events, and MAC address table changes.

routers.question: How many network routers forward routing and ACL event logs?
routers.helperText: Router logs including routing table changes, BGP events, ACL hits, and interface state changes.

firewalls.question: How many next-generation firewall appliances will send traffic and threat logs to Splunk?
firewalls.helperText: Next-generation firewall traffic, threat, URL, and VPN logs from perimeter and internal devices.

fw_perimeter.question: How many internet-facing perimeter firewalls handle north-south traffic?
fw_perimeter.helperText: Internet-facing firewall traffic and threat logs (north-south).

fw_internal.question: How many internal segmentation firewalls enforce east-west zone boundaries?
fw_internal.helperText: Internal segmentation firewall logs for east-west traffic between zones.

fw_waf.question: How many web application firewall instances protect HTTP/HTTPS applications?
fw_waf.helperText: Web application firewall HTTP/S request and block logs.

ddos.question: How many DDoS mitigation services or scrubbing centers forward attack logs?
ddos.helperText: DDoS mitigation platform logs including attack detection, traffic scrubbing, and rate limiting events.

vpn.question: How many VPN concentrators or SSL VPN gateways log user connections?
vpn.helperText: VPN gateway connection and authentication logs from concentrators and SSL VPN appliances.

proxy.question: How many web proxy or secure web gateway appliances log user URL activity?
proxy.helperText: Web proxy URL, category, and policy enforcement logs.

nac.question: How many NAC policy servers assess device posture and admission decisions?
nac.helperText: NAC platform logs including device posture assessment, network admission decisions, and quarantine events.

wireless.question: How many wireless access points or controllers forward client association logs?
wireless.helperText: Wireless controller and access point logs including client associations, rogue AP detection, and authentication events.

dns.question: How many internal DNS resolvers or authoritative servers forward query logs?
dns.helperText: Internal DNS query and response logs from resolvers and authoritative servers.

dpi.question: How many deep packet inspection or full-packet-capture systems forward network data?
dpi.helperText: Full packet capture and deep packet inspection data providing complete network transaction visibility.

dhcp.question: How many DHCP servers forward lease assignment logs?
dhcp.helperText: DHCP lease logs mapping IP addresses to MAC addresses and hostnames over time.

loadbalancer.question: How many load balancer appliances or virtual instances forward traffic logs?
loadbalancer.helperText: Load balancer logs including traffic distribution, health checks, SSL termination events, and connection metadata.

storage_prod.question: How many production storage arrays forward access and performance logs?
storage_prod.helperText: Storage array logs including access patterns, performance metrics, and administrative changes for production data stores.

ics_scada.question: How many ICS or SCADA systems (PLCs, HMIs, historians) forward operational logs?
ics_scada.helperText: Industrial control system logs including SCADA events, PLC state changes, and process variable anomalies.

asset_cmdb.question: How many asset inventory or identity directory sources feed enrichment data?
asset_cmdb.helperText: Asset inventory, identity directory, and CMDB data used for enrichment and context in security operations.

ot_security.question: How many OT network security sensors or OT IDS platforms are deployed?
ot_security.helperText: OT-specific intrusion detection and asset discovery platform logs.

uba.question: How many users does your UEBA baseline and analyze?
uba.helperText: Interactable workforce identities monitored by UEBA product (usually matches HR-active users).
